items.q: How are your used trucks inspected?
items.a: Each qualifying unit goes through a comprehensive 150-point Mack Certified inspection.

items.q: Do your used trucks come with a warranty?
items.a: Yes. Many units qualify for a 90-day / 25,000-mile factory-backed warranty, with additional options available depending on eligibility.

items.q: Where do your used trucks come from?
items.a: Most inventory comes from fleet turnover and trade-ins rather than auction purchases.

items.q: What types of used trucks do you sell most?
items.a: Day cab tractors and low-mileage dump trucks are among the most common inventory types.

items.q: How do I avoid buying the wrong used truck?
items.a: Work with a trusted dealership, verify inspection quality, review maintenance history, and ensure the truck matches your operational application.
